en: Conditioned by a state not to be abandoned by seeing and not unwholesome, there arises a wholesome state not to be abandoned either by seeing or by cultivation, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state not to be abandoned by seeing and not unwholesome, there arises an unwholesome state to be abandoned by seeing, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a not-indeterminate state that is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a not-indeterminate state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six under root, six under predominance … pe … six under non-disappearance.
